description: SuperGemma4 26B Uncensored is Jiunsong’s tuned Gemma 4 mixture-of-experts model for conversation, writing and coding, with 26B total parameters and about 4B active per token. It accepts text and one image, supports function calling and JSON-schema output, and offers a 256,000-token context window with up to 8,192 output tokens.
name: SuperGemma4 26B Uncensored
